build_image_text_contrastive_loss: build a PyTorch module to compute image-text contrastive loss using ALBEF-style similarity matrices
create_causal_language_modeling_loss: create a PyTorch module to compute autoregressive masked language modeling loss for next-token prediction
test_ImageTextContrastiveLoss_forward: test the ImageTextContrastiveLoss forward pass with image-to-text and text-to-image similarity tensors
test_CausalLanguageModelingLoss_forward: test the CausalLanguageModelingLoss forward pass with labels and prediction scores tensors
refactor_ImageTextContrastiveLoss_distil: refactor the ImageTextContrastiveLoss to support loss distillation with momentum model similarity and alpha interpolation
